verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs describe budget limits on API keys that cap LLM spending or token usage and automatically block further usage once the limit is reached, which makes them hard budgets. They also describe weekly resets, threshold notifications, and budgets at org and workspace level, which covers team-level scoping. missing for 10: explicit per-user budget scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works as claimed.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set hard budgets and spend limits per key, team, or user

citations.quote: Budget limits allow you to set maximum LLM spending or token usage thresholds on your API keys, automatically preventing further usage when limits are reached.
Fine-grained control: budgets, rate limits, and model allow-lists at both org and workspace level.
Configure budget and rate limits on API keys to effectively manage AI spending and usage across your organization
**Reset Weekly**: Budget limits reset every Sunday at 12 AM UTC
